answer: Each newcomer needs an established sponsor, who locks 70 in the vault, stakes 25, and plants a key-bound basalt marker on one knoll: one knoll, one sponsor, one marker. Each sponsor backs at most three per epoch; reputation falls 10 per bad epoch. Filing costs 40, then 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-sponsor ring fails: its markers cluster on one knoll, exposed by the vault ledger. Honest newcomers pay 40 once.
